Rams vs Broncos DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, September 27 · NFL Week 3 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of September 27, 11:46 AM ET

Bo Nix carries the highest SPAGS model projection in Sunday Night Football's Rams at Broncos DraftKings Showdown slate: 16.7 DraftKings points at a $10,000 FLEX salary, or 25.1 at captain for $15,000. Nix holds the largest share of simulated winning-lineup credit at 69% across 10,000 simulations, and Davante Adams holds the largest captain share at 15.3%.

Behind Nix, the next four projections are Davante Adams (16.6, $10,200), Matthew Stafford (16.6, $10,400), Kyren Williams (15.6, $8,600) and Jaylen Waddle (12.5, $9,600). The Rams are a 1.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 43.5, with implied team totals of 21 for the Broncos and 22.5 for the Rams.

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the September 27, 11:46 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Davante Adams, LAR WR ($10,200 FLEX / $15,300 CPT)

Davante Adams holds 15.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,300 and the 16.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 24.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 8.9 targets on 23.3 routes. The current projection of 16.6 compares with a saved model baseline of 12.0. Across 10,000 simulations Adams averaged 16.9 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 35.4. He holds 60% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.3% as the captain and 44.9% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Kyren Williams, LAR RB ($8,600 FLEX / $12,900 CPT)

Kyren Williams holds 15.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $12,900 and the 15.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 14.4 carries and 3.2 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 15.5 points with a simulated floor of 5.7 and a ceiling of 30.4. He holds 58% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.2% as the captain and 42.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Bo Nix, DEN QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Bo Nix holds 13.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 16.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 3.9 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Nix averaged 16.9 points with a simulated floor of 6.6 and a ceiling of 31.1. He holds 69% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.0% as the captain and 56.0% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Rams vs Broncos

Matthew Stafford, LAR QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Matthew Stafford carries the 3rd-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 16.6 DraftKings points for a $10,400 FLEX salary ($15,600 at captain). Across 10,000 simulations Stafford averaged 16.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.4 and a ceiling of 30.7. He holds 66% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.7% as the captain and 55.1% in a FLEX spot.

Jaylen Waddle, DEN WR ($9,600 FLEX / $14,400 CPT)

Jaylen Waddle carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.5 DraftKings points for a $9,600 FLEX salary ($14,400 at captain). The model gives him 7.5 targets on 24.9 routes. The current projection of 12.5 compares with a saved model baseline of 10.6. Across 10,000 simulations Waddle averaged 12.7 points with a simulated floor of 3.6 and a ceiling of 29.1. He holds 39% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.5% as the captain and 31.6% in a FLEX spot.

J.K. Dobbins, DEN RB ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

J.K. Dobbins carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.2 DraftKings points for a $7,400 FLEX salary ($11,100 at captain). The model gives him 13.7 carries and 1.3 targets. The current projection of 11.2 compares with a saved model baseline of 9.1. Across 10,000 simulations Dobbins averaged 11.3 points with a simulated floor of 1.6 and a ceiling of 28.5. He holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.1% as the captain and 23.9% in a FLEX spot.

Courtland Sutton, DEN WR ($7,600 FLEX / $11,400 CPT)

Courtland Sutton carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 9.8 DraftKings points for a $7,600 FLEX salary ($11,400 at captain). The model gives him 6.1 targets on 27.0 routes. The current projection of 9.8 compares with a saved model baseline of 8.8. Across 10,000 simulations Sutton averaged 9.9 points with a simulated floor of 1.4 and a ceiling of 24.9. He holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.7% as the captain and 22.0% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Xavier Smith, LAR WR ($1,200 FLEX / $1,800 CPT)

Xavier Smith projects for 4.1 DraftKings points at a $1,200 FLEX salary, 3.44 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.1 targets on 11.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Smith averaged 4.1 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.8. He holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.5% as the captain and 9.4% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Terrance Ferguson, LAR TE ($3,800 FLEX / $5,700 CPT)

Terrance Ferguson projects for 9.1 DraftKings points at a $3,800 FLEX salary, 2.38 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 5.1 targets on 17.2 routes. The current projection of 9.1 compares with a saved model baseline of 6.6. Across 10,000 simulations Ferguson averaged 9.1 points with a simulated floor of 1.8 and a ceiling of 22.3. He holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.8% as the captain and 27.5% in a FLEX spot.
